tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.15.8
Also named: a.ga.gi (אֲגָגִי "Agagite" H0091)
§ Agag = "I will overtop"
king of Amalek, spared by Saul but slain by Samuel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings
strongs_1890.derivation: or אֲגָג; of uncertain derivation (compare H89 (אָגֵא)); flame;
